title: An existence result for fractional problems with mixed boundary conditions
summary: In this paper we investigate the existence and qualitative properties of weak solutions for a class of nonlinear fractional equations driven by the spectral fractional Laplacian under mixed Dirichlet--Neumann boundary conditions.
